	### Compatibility
944f4dda5f784e266310978b31f65b3d452e6387 36 36
	
944f4dda5f784e266310978b31f65b3d452e6387 37 37
	Mirrors renderMembershipPanel over renderPanelSection with data-panel-type=membership: title aliases title/label/heading/name (default Membership), subtitle aliases subtitle/description/metadata, and summary/text/body/emptyMessage fill the content area only without authored children. The saved-schema directives membershipsField, hierarchyField, roleField and permissionField are consumed by codegen and left unbound: the HTML renderer reads no membership, hierarchy, role or permission data.
